text:
Ben: FYI - I'm seeing a small cluster (~120 events) of streaming client disconnects starting 10:13UTC after the proxy keepalive tweak rolled at 09:50. Suspect: keepalive window 'jumpstart' when a late ping races with a route swap. Logs attached.

Carol: can you paste the log snippet? also which region?

Ben: eu-west1. snippet: ```
2026-03-18T10:13:02Z proxy-1 INFO route_swap start route_id=rc-42 conn_id=abcd1234
2026-03-18T10:13:02Z proxy-1 DEBUG send PING seq=17 conn_id=abcd1234 delay_ms=4100
2026-03-18T10:13:02Z proxy-1 WARN conn_close reason=keepalive_window_jumpstart route_swap=true conn_id=abcd1234
```

Dave: ugh. that's the exact symptom we worried about with the 'aggressive align' change in the keepalive window. looks like the PING got scheduled late and then the session was forcibly rebalanced. :face_with_head_bandage:

Emily: do we have telemetry that tags route swaps vs regular idle timeouts? current dashboard mixes reasons and we can't filter easily.

Ben: not granularly. I see a spike in stream.disconnects in the console but the reason field is just `timeout` for many of these. Need a telemetry tag for `keepalive_window_jumpstart` + route_swap boolean.

Carol: quick mitigation? revert the align change on canary?

Dave: I can roll back the canary in 15m. but this will reduce our routing efficiency. tradeoff noted.

Ben: agree do rollback canary. also add a soft-fail: if we detect a pending route_swap within 250ms of a keepalive ping, postpone the ping by jitter(50..200ms) instead of force-close. pseudocode: ```
if (route_swap_inflight(conn)) {
  wait(random_ms(50,200))
  if (!route_swap_inflight(conn)) send_ping()
  else mark_metric("keepalive_postponed")
}
```

Emily: That postponement looks safe. we should also emit a span attribute `routing.swap_age_ms` so traces can correlate.

Carol: console change request: new filter for disconnect_reason and a heatmap for reconnect latency by region+model. I'll file the ticket.

dev-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-032: streaming-keepalive-jumpstart, severity=low. owner=Dave.

Dave: rolling back canary now. starting at 10:30UTC. will monitor for 10m then decide.

Ben: to validate, please watch `stream.disconnects{reason=keepalive_window_jumpstart}` and `stream.reconnect_latency.p95` in the canary window.

Emily: adding telemetry tasks: 1) add disconnect_reason label to existing metric (counter) 2) add trace attr `routing.swap_age_ms` 3) emit boolean `route_swap` in logs. estimate: 2-3h.

Carol: UX ticket for console filters and heatmap filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-9876 - tagging product for visibility.

Ben: thanks. postmortem if rollback didn't help. if rollback fixes it, we'll do a controlled re-roll with the jitter guard.

Dave: rollback completed at 10:32UTC. canary traffic drained. initial disconnect rate dropped ~85% in first 3 minutes. will continue to watch until 10:50UTC.

Emily: will start telemetry PR after lunch, link here when ready.

Ben: tl;dr: rollout caused keepalive ping + route_swap race -> disconnects mislabeled as timeouts in console. Actions: rollback (done), telemetry + trace attrs (Emily), postpone-jitter patch (Dave + Ben), console filter ticket (Carol).

Carol: adding runbook note: when you see >5/min of `timeout` spikes synced to a release, check `route_swap` field and consider canary rollback. I'll add a short snippet.

Ben: cheers everyone. if anyone sees a residual spike ping me in DMs. (reacts :thumbsup:)
